properties.tier_label: Very High Cyclone & Storm Surge Risk
properties.wind_speed_kmh: Up to 250 km/h (Super Cyclonic Storm / Category 4-5)
properties.coastal_belt: East Coast (Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry)
properties.source: NDMA National Cyclone Risk Mitigation Project (NCRMP) & IMD
properties.description: Exposed to severe Bay of Bengal post-monsoon and pre-monsoon cyclonic storms. Catastrophic storm surge inundation documented up to 10-15 km inland in low-elevation deltaic flats.
properties.mitigation_notes: Structures require aerodynamically designed roofs, RCC shear cores, and compliance with Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ-II/III) setbacks with elevated plinths.

properties.tier_label: High to Moderate Cyclone & Coastal Exposure
properties.wind_speed_kmh: 120 to 180 km/h (Very Severe Cyclonic Storm / Cat 2-3)
properties.coastal_belt: West Coast (Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, Kerala)
properties.description: Arabian Sea coastal reaches exposed to tropical cyclones (e.g. Tauktae 2021, Nisarga 2020), extreme marine gale winds, coastal sea-water erosion, and estuary tidal surges.
properties.mitigation_notes: Strict corrosion-resistant marine epoxy coatings on reinforcement; storm shutters on all windward fenestrations.
